newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's IGCP shows it wants lower auction rates.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's IGCP shows it wants lower auction rates.

text.p: Portugal's Institute for Public Credit Management's rejection of bids at its six-month bill auction on Monday sent a clear signal that it was looking for lower rates at a 45 billion escudo bond sale later in the day, dealers said.
They said the bids at the six-month sale were clearly not seen as aggressive enough after the Bank of Portugal cut its money market rates 30 basis points on Friday.
"The Credit Institute wants to give a clear signal that it expects lower rates today on the bonds," said one dealer.
The Institute will be offering 15 billion escudos each of three, five and 10 year bonds with results due around 1000 GMT.
